sql: BEGIN

SELECT 1
            FROM documents, json_tree(documents.document, '$.v') AS candidate
            WHERE db_name = 'probe' AND coll_name = 'records'
              AND CASE WHEN candidate.type = 'object'
                       THEN json_extract(candidate.value, '$."$mongoeco".type') END = 'int64'
            LIMIT 1

SELECT 1
            FROM documents, json_tree(documents.document, '$.v') AS candidate
            WHERE db_name = 'probe' AND coll_name = 'records'
              AND CASE WHEN candidate.type = 'object'
                       THEN json_extract(candidate.value, '$."$mongoeco".type') END = 'decimal'
            LIMIT 1

SELECT 1
            FROM documents, json_tree(documents.document, '$.v') AS candidate
            WHERE db_name = 'probe' AND coll_name = 'records'
              AND CASE WHEN candidate.type = 'object'
                       THEN json_extract(candidate.value, '$."$mongoeco".type') END = 'decimal128'
            LIMIT 1

SELECT 1
            FROM documents, json_tree(documents.document, '$.v') AS candidate
            WHERE db_name = 'probe' AND coll_name = 'records'
              AND CASE WHEN candidate.type = 'object'
                       THEN json_extract(candidate.value, '$."$mongoeco".type') END = 'decimal128_public'
            LIMIT 1

SELECT 1
            FROM documents, json_tree(documents.document, '$._id') AS candidate
            WHERE db_name = 'probe' AND coll_name = 'records'
              AND CASE WHEN candidate.type = 'object'
                       THEN json_extract(candidate.value, '$."$mongoeco".type') END = 'bytes'
            LIMIT 1

SELECT 1
            FROM documents, json_tree(documents.document, '$._id') AS candidate
            WHERE db_name = 'probe' AND coll_name = 'records'
              AND CASE WHEN candidate.type = 'object'
                       THEN json_extract(candidate.value, '$."$mongoeco".type') END = 'undefined'
            LIMIT 1

SELECT 1
            FROM documents
            WHERE db_name = 'probe' AND coll_name = 'records' AND ((COALESCE(json_extract(document, '$.v."$mongoeco".type'), '') IN ('bytes', 'binary', 'uuid')) OR (json_type(document, '$.v') = 'array' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(document, '$.v') WHERE CASE WHEN json_each.type = 'object' THEN COALESCE(json_extract(json_each.value, '$."$mongoeco".type'), '') ELSE '' END IN ('bytes', 'binary', 'uuid'))))
              AND (
                json_type(document, '$._id') = 'array'
                OR (
                    json_type(document, '$._id') = 'object'
                    AND COALESCE(json_extract(document, '$._id."$mongoeco".type'), '') IN (
                        '', 'int64', 'decimal', 'decimal128', 'decimal128_public'
                    )
                )
              )
            LIMIT 1

SELECT
                COUNT(*),
                SUM(CASE WHEN json_type(document, '$._id') IN ('integer', 'real') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
                SUM(CASE WHEN json_type(document, '$._id') = 'text' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
                SUM(CASE WHEN json_type(document, '$._id') IN ('true', 'false') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            FROM documents
            WHERE db_name = 'probe' AND coll_name = 'records'

SELECT document FROM documents WHERE db_name = 'probe' AND coll_name = 'records' AND ((COALESCE(json_extract(document, '$.v."$mongoeco".type'), '') = 'datetime') OR (json_type(document, '$.v') = 'array' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(document, '$.v') WHERE CASE WHEN json_each.type = 'object' THEN COALESCE(json_extract(json_each.value, '$."$mongoeco".type'), '') ELSE '' END = 'datetime')))  ORDER BY COALESCE(json_extract(document, '$._id."$mongoeco".value'), json_extract(document, '$._id')) ASC
BEGIN

SELECT 1
            FROM documents
            WHERE db_name = 'probe' AND coll_name = 'records' AND ((COALESCE(json_extract(document, '$.a."$mongoeco".type'), '') = 'datetime') OR (json_type(document, '$.a') = 'array' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(document, '$.a') WHERE CASE WHEN json_each.type = 'object' THEN COALESCE(json_extract(json_each.value, '$."$mongoeco".type'), '') ELSE '' END = 'datetime')))
              AND (
                json_type(document, '$._id') = 'array'
                OR (
                    json_type(document, '$._id') = 'object'
                    AND COALESCE(json_extract(document, '$._id."$mongoeco".type'), '') IN (
                        '', 'int64', 'decimal', 'decimal128', 'decimal128_public'
                    )
                )
              )
            LIMIT 1
